method.unit: one fresh Simulation(template, seed) per (seed, device, attack); attacks that require an AI assistant run on AI-enabled devices only
method.assessment: safeguard_pq.orchestrator.AssessmentPipeline.run(sim.to_request(device)) with llm_report=False, llm_provider=none, online tools disabled; S = pq_risk_score (0-100, crypto-only by design), status = environment_status (SAFE < AT_RISK < UNSAFE), tippss_min = lowest TIPPSS pillar score, live_risk = the simulator's own 0-100 live risk (includes telemetry alerts)
method.phases: baseline -> inject -> 2 ticks -> reassess -> apply every mitigation in Attack.blocked_by -> 2 ticks -> reassess -> re-inject the same attack
method.detected: at least one (agent, finding type) pair produced after the attack by an agent in Attack.detected_by that was absent at baseline; flagged_after_attack also accepts findings already present at baseline
method.preconditions_absent: hndl_capture on a PQ/hybrid key exchange; pq_strip without a PQ key share; any injection the simulator refuses (e.g. cert_spoof on ML-DSA certificates); excluded from all rates
method.reinjection_blocked: the simulator refused the second injection (a mitigation in blocked_by is present); hndl_capture: key exchange PQ-safe after mitigation
method.kill_chain: replay of the UI drill (frontend/src/components/drill.ts) with fleet-level assessment after each step
method.determinism: no timestamps or random identifiers are recorded; seeds fix telemetry and the optimizer

caveat: Synthetic simulator (safeguard_pq.simulation): the fleet, telemetry, attack effects and mitigations are modelled, not observed. Detections are configuration and telemetry-rule checks performed by the assessment agents, so detection rates measure whether the agents react to the simulator's modelled effects, not detection of real attacks. 'Blocked' reflects the simulator's mitigation model (a mitigation listed in the attack's blocked_by prevents re-injection), not the behaviour of a real adversary. pq_risk_score is crypto-only by design, so network, AI and identity attacks mostly change environment status, TIPPSS pillars and the live risk rather than the PQ score; devices that are UNSAFE at baseline because of classical crypto cannot get a worse status.
